The reconnaissance system has detected a large-scale mechanical force entering the outer periphery of the Asteroid Belt's Fifth Mining Zone. The formation size is extremely large, with an initial estimate of over five figures, and is still being reinforced.

The only realistic goal is to continuously inflict damage and weaken the enemy from the flanks, reducing the pressure on the main defense line and buying time and space for subsequent operations.
